L37:                                      AN ACT
L38: 
L39: 
L40: 
L41:         To amend the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978 to
L42:       establish a Federal standard relating to the recovery of the full,
L43:     incremental costs of upgrades that serve large-load customers, and for
L44:                                 other purposes.
L45: 
L46:         Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the
L47:     United States of America in Congress assembled,
L48: 
L49:     SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE.
L50:         This Act may be cited as the ``Ratepayer Protection Act''.
L51: 
L52:     SEC. 2. FEDERAL STANDARD RELATING TO LARGE-LOAD CUSTOMERS.
L53: 
L54:         (a) Federal Standard Relating to Large-load Customers.--Section
L55:     111(d) of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978 (16 U.S.C.
L56:     2621(d)) is amended by adding at the end the following:
L57:                 ``(22) Standards for large-load customers.--
L58:                         ``(A) Recovery of full, incremental cost of
L59:                     upgrades.--A rate charged, or entered into, by an
L60:                     electric utility for providing electric service to a
L61:                     large-load customer shall be designed to recover from
L62:                     the large-load customer the full, incremental cost of
L63:                     any generation, transmission, or distribution upgrade
L64:                     necessary to serve the load of such large-load
L65:                     customer, including in the event of such large-load
L66:                     customer terminating a contract or other agreement with
L67:                     the electric utility pertaining to the sale of electric
L68:                     energy, or otherwise ceasing the purchase of electric
L69:                     energy from the electric utility.
L70:                         ``(B) Financial assurances and contributions.--
L71:                     Before making any generation, transmission, or
L72:                     distribution upgrade that is necessary to serve the
L73:                     load of a large-load customer, an electric utility
L74:                     shall require the large-load customer provide to the
L75:                     electric utility financial assurances or contributions
L76:                     to cover the cost of such upgrade.
L77:                         ``(C) Large-load customer defined.--In this
L78:                     paragraph, the term `large-load customer' means a non-
L79:                     residential electric consumer that, on or after the
L80:                     date of the enactment of this paragraph, requests to
L81:                     enter into, or enters into, a contract or other
L82:                     agreement pertaining to the sale of electric energy for
L83:                     one or more facilities that--
L84:                                 ``(i) require electric energy primarily to
L85:                             operate information technology infrastructure
L86:                             and related systems pertaining to data storage
L87:                             and computational applications and services;
L88:                             and
L89:                                 ``(ii) have, in the aggregate, a peak
L90:                             electric demand of 100 megawatts or more at a
L91:                             single site or campus.''.
L92:         (b) Conforming Amendments.--
L93:                 (1) Obligations to consider and determine.--Section 112 of
L94:             the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978 (16 U.S.C.
L95:             2622) is amended--
L96:                         (A) in subsection (b), by adding at the end the
L97:                     following:
L98:                 ``(9)(A) Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment
L99:             of this paragraph, each State regulatory authority (with
L100:             respect to each electric utility for which the State has
L101:             ratemaking authority) and each nonregulated electric utility
L102:             shall commence consideration under section 111, or set a
L103:             hearing date for consideration, with respect to the standard
L104:             established by paragraph (22) of section 111(d).
L105:                 ``(B) Not later than 2 years after the date of enactment of
L106:             this paragraph, each State regulatory authority (with respect
L107:             to each electric utility for which the State has ratemaking
L108:             authority) and each nonregulated electric utility shall
L109:             complete the consideration and make the determination under
L110:             section 111 with respect to the standard established by
L111:             paragraph (22) of section 111(d).'';
L112:                         (B) in subsection (c)--
L113:                                 (i) by striking ``subsection (b)(2)'' and
L114:                             inserting ``subsection (b)''; and
L115:                                 (ii) by inserting ``In the case of the
L116:                             standard established by paragraph (22) of
L117:                             section 111(d), the reference contained in this
L118:                             subsection to the date of enactment of this Act
L119:                             shall be deemed to be a reference to the date
L120:                             of enactment of that paragraph (22).'' after
L121:                             ``paragraph (21).''; and
L122:                         (C) by adding at the end the following:
L123:         ``(i) Other Prior State Actions.--Subsections (b) and (c) shall not
L124:     apply to the standard established by paragraph (22) of section 111(d)
L125:     in the case of any electric utility in a State if, before the date of
L126:     enactment of this subsection--
L127:                 ``(1) the State has implemented for the electric utility
L128:             the standard (or a comparable standard);
L129:                 ``(2) the State regulatory authority for the State or the
L130:             relevant nonregulated electric utility has conducted a
L131:             proceeding to consider implementation of the standard (or a
L132:             comparable standard) for the electric utility; or
L133:                 ``(3) the State legislature has voted on the implementation
L134:             of the standard (or a comparable standard) for the electric
L135:             utility.''.
L136:                 (2) Prior and pending proceedings.--Section 124 of the
L137:             Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978 (16 U.S.C. 2634)
L138:             is amended by adding at the end the following: ``In the case of
L139:             the standard established by paragraph (22) of section 111(d),
L140:             the reference contained in this section to the date of
L141:             enactment of this Act shall be deemed to be a reference to the
L142:             date of enactment of that paragraph (22).''.
